 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Sports Sports Alex Eala to start Hong Kong Open bid vs. Emerson Jones as Alycia Parks withdraws with shoulder injury 
 By GMA News Published November 3, 2026 7:06pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Photo: Hong Kong Tennis Open/X Alex Eala has a new opponent in her first match at the Hong Kong Open following the withdrawal of American Alycia Parks, who sustained a right shoulder injury and pulled out hours after their scheduled match Tuesday night. 
 The Filipina star will instead take on 18-year-old Australian Emerson Jones in the Round of 32 as she seeks to end her season on a high note. 
 Jones, a former junior star who has two Grand Slam junior finals appearances, is currently ranked No. 132 in the WTA rankings and had a career-high No. 122 last month. 
 Eala and Jones have yet to face each other in the WTA tour, marking their impending Hong Kong Open clash their maiden meeting.
